name: Mackerel
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated during SIBO treatment phases. High in omega-3 fatty acids which may help reduce gut inflammation.
preparationTips: Grill, bake, or pan-sear with FODMAP-friendly herbs like basil or oregano
Avoid high-FODMAP marinades containing garlic or onion
Season with lemon juice, salt, and allowed spices
Fresh mackerel should smell ocean-fresh, not fishy
nutritionalHighlights: High in omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA
Rich in vitamin B12 and selenium
